topics.answer: Cozy Digital builds websites and landing pages, produces AI video and ad creative, and connects booking and follow-up workflows. Quincy and Kayson also help with content, website updates, and search visibility. What are you working on?

We design and build websites and landing pages around your business, with booking or checkout where you need it. We can also improve an existing site after checking the platform and access. Browse our work or book a call to talk through your project.

We handle video concepts, scripts, generated scenes, editing, sound, captions, and brand details. You can watch our selected films for Dr. Boyce Watkins on the homepage. Length, formats, and revisions are agreed for each project.
Our homepage has client websites and AI films. Website examples include Dr. Alicia Watkins, Dear Pastor’s Wife, and Essential Massage by Mesha. The film showcase features work for Dr. Boyce Watkins.

Start with our free live AI video workshop, From Idea to AI Video. The workshop page has the current date, time, what you’ll learn, and Luma registration. Open it to reserve your spot and receive event details.

You can start with our free live AI video workshop or explore AI Video Prompt Boss, our downloadable PDF playbook. The workshop page shows the current registration details; the courses page has the available learning options.

AI Video Prompt Boss is our 70-page downloadable PDF playbook with 120 prompts, cheat sheets, storyboards, and an AI Director master prompt. Its product page shows the current price and purchase details.

Current service plans and credits are listed in the Client Hub. For a custom website or video project, we agree on the deliverables and confirm your price in writing before work starts. The consultation is free.

Book a free 30-minute consultation with Cozy Digital. We’ll discuss your website, video, or business goals and recommend a next step. Choose an available time on our booking page; calls use Google Meet.
Our Digital Presence Audit is free. Share your website or social profile and Quincy and Kayson will email three changes they would make first, with an explanation. There’s no requirement to hire us.

Existing clients can sign in to the Client Hub to view work, progress, and requests. I can’t access accounts, orders, or private project details. For account help or a payment question, contact the team directly.

Cozy Digital is an independent digital studio run by Quincy and Kayson. They work directly with clients on websites, AI video, and the booking and customer workflows behind them. I’m the website’s automated guide.
You can email the Cozy Digital team at quincy@cozydigital.org or book a free consultation. I’m an automated guide, so messages here don’t book an appointment or send a message to the team.

Timing depends on the pages, video deliverables, integrations, and content involved. We agree on milestones before starting. Share your deadline on a consultation so the team can confirm what’s possible.

Project work has a defined scope and a clear end, and you own what we build when it’s done. Ongoing support runs month to month with no long-term contract. The team can confirm the terms for your project.

We prepare ad creative, video, post ideas, captions, email copy, and reusable templates around your offers. Channels, deliverables, and publishing schedules are agreed in your scope. Talk with the team about the audience you want to reach.
We connect forms, calendars, reminders, and customer emails. First we map who should receive each inquiry and what should happen next, then build and test the workflow.

We review your website, profiles, service information, FAQs, structured data, and crawler access to improve how search engines and AI tools understand your business. Search providers decide what appears, so rankings and mentions aren’t guaranteed.
Our free playbook is available from the Free Playbook page. If you’re looking for the AI video prompt collection instead, that’s the separate AI Video Prompt Boss PDF.
